newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed in slower trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed in slower trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed in slower trade on Thursday.
* Volume halved to 5,946 kuna, turnover shrank to 2.1 million kuna.
* Of ten active issues five rose, three fell and two were flat.
* Biggest gainer cable maker Elka inched up eight kuna to 175, selling 110 shares.
* Biggest decliner hotelier Laguna lost 40 kuna to 1,400 on volume of 21 shares.
* Most actively traded issue food processor Podravka held its ground at 319.9 kuna with 2,620 units sold. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 395-1-4557075
